page_title: BRA 4-1 KOR | Brazil v South Korea 05/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
90+3' Richarlison (Brazil) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brazil will have a goal kick.
90' Brazil win a corner.
89' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Dani Alves (Brazil), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
88' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Raphinha (Brazil).
88' Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
87' The South Korea players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
85' The ball is cleared after Raphinha (Brazil) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Brazil.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rodrygo (Brazil) comes onto the pitch for Neymar.
80' Alisson goes off the pitch and Weverton (Brazil) comes on.
80' Paulo Bento has decided to substitute Gue-Sung Cho and he is replaced by Ui-Jo Hwang (South Korea).
80' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) heads on.

76' 4 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Seung-Ho Paik (South Korea) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Alisson just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 4:1.
76' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Clement Turpin saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to South Korea.
74' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee will be replaced by Kang-In Lee (South Korea).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vinicius Junior walks off the pitch to be replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil).
72' Here is a change. Danilo is going off and Tite gives the last tactical orders to Bremer (Brazil).
71' The attendance is 43847.
69' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from South Korea was in an offside position.
69' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
65' Here comes a substitution. In-Beom Hwang is given a rest as he is replaced by Seung-Ho Paik (South Korea).
65' Brazil are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
64' Richarlison (Brazil) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
63' Raphinha (Brazil) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
63' Substitution. Dani Alves (Brazil) in, Eder Militao out.

62' Seung-Gyu Kim pulls off a great save to deny Raphinha (Brazil), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play. Brazil are awarded a corner kick.
58' Neymar (Brazil) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
57' Raphinha (Brazil) tries to bend in the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall makes an easy block. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brazil are going to take it.
56' Jun-Ho Son (South Korea) brings his opponent down. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Brazil win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
55' Raphinha (Brazil) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.
54' Casemiro (Brazil) smashes the ball upfield and Raphinha brings it down with a fine first touch.
52' South Korea are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
48' The resulting set piece from South Korea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

48' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The referee signals a corner kick to South Korea.
46' The game is over for Woo-Young Jung. Jun-Ho Son (South Korea) comes on for the second half.
46' Paulo Bento has made a change at the break. Chul Hong (South Korea) has come on in place of Jin-Su Kim.
46' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by In-Beom Hwang (South Korea).
45+4' Richarlison (Brazil) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
45+2' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45+1' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Seung-Gyu Kim easily makes the save.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Woo-Young Jung (South Korea) for a tough tackle.
42' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

40' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
36' 4 - 0 Goal! Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
35' Casemiro (Brazil) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Brazil are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
29' 3 - 0 Goal! Richarlison (Brazil) takes a short pass from Thiago Silva in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
28' Brazil failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Neymar (Brazil) takes the corner with a short pass.
26' Neymar (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Brazil can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

25' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. South Korea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Danilo (Brazil) sends a cross into the box, but Seung-Gyu Kim comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
21' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' Neymar (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' South Korea take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

17' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Alisson stops the ball from going inside the top right corner. South Korea will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' 2 - 0 Goal! Neymar (Brazil) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Seung-Gyu Kim to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
12' Neymar (Brazil) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
11' Dangerous play by Woo-Young Jung (South Korea). Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Brazil.
10' Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call. Brazil have a free kick.
7' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Neymar laid the ball off to Vinicius Junior (Brazil), who shot from close range into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
7' Brazil keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
7' One of the players from South Korea times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Raphinha (Brazil). Clement Turpin saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
5' Flag up against Heung-Min Son (South Korea). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
3' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' Flag goes up against Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
South Korea will kick-off.
Clement Turpin is the one to supervise the game today.
